standards_reference: W3C Web App Manifest & Chromium PWA Installability Specifications

secure_context.detail: Android Chrome strictly requires HTTPS for non-localhost origins. Remote LAN IP 192.168.0.14 over HTTP is marked Insecure, blocking PWA installation and getUserMedia.

service_worker.detail: Minimal network-first service worker (sw.js) registered and activated. Bypasses APIs and WebSockets to prevent stale agent state.

web_manifest.detail: manifest.webmanifest specifies name, short_name, start_url (/), display (standalone), background_color, theme_color, and icons.

icons.detail: Provides 192x192 PNG, 512x512 PNG, and SVG maskable/any icons.

media_devices_access.detail: Microphone permission for local voice STT is enabled by Secure Context (HTTPS).
